scope: A0 P2 strengthening 3A: authoritative data-driven port and service capability
changes: extends the existing SettlementEconomicProfile authority with medicalCapability instead of creating a separate service database
adds one generic port service quote engine backed by settlement shipyard/medical capability and the live A0.1C market
makes ship repair availability, restoration limit, cost and time depend on yard capability, damage scope and current raw/manufactured stock
makes successful ship repairs consume the same live market rows used by the economy and records those source rows in canonical history
makes refit availability, price and duration depend on yard capability, specialist capability and current material stock
preserves the accepted Veyrholm Storm Rigging 12-hour flow while allowing authored specialist differences at other yards
makes injury treatment capability-dependent by severity, resource-dependent on live medical stock, and world-time consuming
allows smaller medical services to treat supported injuries while leaving severe unsupported injuries active for later stronger care
preserves A0.1C provisioning as the one live food-market supply path
preserves the existing settlement-profile/regional-availability Outfitter path rather than creating a parallel equipment inventory
keeps Harbor and Captain interactions as concise one-click actions with data-derived price/time/availability
contains no named-port branches in the service engine; later ports inherit behavior through capability data
updates historical package-version regression gates to recognize the A0.3A continuation package
adds eleven dedicated A0.3A capability/economy/expansion-safety tests

cohesion.port_capability: SettlementEconomicProfile and its shipyard/medical fields are the service capability authority
cohesion.a0_1c_economy: GameState.markets remains live material/provision truth; successful repair/refit/treatment consumes those rows rather than a new service inventory
cohesion.ship_repair: repairShip remains the mutation owner; portServices only quotes what the current facility/resources can support
cohesion.ship_refit: installRefit remains the refit mutation owner; service capability gates and prices the existing refit definitions
cohesion.medical: player Injury records remain condition truth; treatment only marks supported existing injuries treated and retains their history
cohesion.provisioning: quoteShipSupplies/consumeSupplyQuote remain the one provisioning owner
cohesion.outfitter: availableItemDefinitionsAtSettlement/itemPurchasePriceAtSettlement remain the one equipment availability/pricing path
cohesion.world_time: repair, refit and treatment elapsed time use GameState.absoluteHour through advanceWorld
cohesion.future_a0_3c: future resource/policy causes can alter the economy/capabilities consumed here without replacing the service owner
cohesion.future_r2: future law/customs restrictions should constrain this same service/market boundary rather than create substitute port services
cohesion.expansion: service behavior is profile/market driven; named settlement differences are data overrides only
cohesion.presentation: accepted screen geometry and art remain unchanged; only concise dynamic service states/cost/time are surfaced

saveCompatibility: schema v12 unchanged; A0.3A adds no persistent campaign lifecycle state
databaseCompatibility: no Supabase migration required; capability is static content data and live resource truth already persists in the canonical market/save state
presentationChanged: no structural redesign; existing service controls now reflect truthful availability/cost/time
deferred: A0.3B character-build consequence and learning-source connection
